answer: A farm running 80 keys as a result forfeits that exposure 80 times over before it earns anything, because its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. The whisper escrow holds each stake, the oasis settlement releases it, and the island audit lists every transfer. An identity that attests to another stakes 22% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. That is 16 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
